g.text: Residual error components in Recovery / Preview
All: all_available; q50: the same fixed known-cohort residual-sigma median rule. Labels give retained/available references.
Positive bars stack right; negative cross terms extend left. Observed energy is the signed sum. Panel scales may differ.
Both seed cohorts were previously observed. Component removal is arithmetic in the recorded frame, without a new rollout or calibrated bound.
